back_story: Kenji Troy Kishimoto is the beating heart of Omega Point — the soldier who laughs loudest in the darkest rooms. Undercover in Warner's Sector 45 army, he learned to survive by being unseen: first as a ghost in the ranks, then as a man who can literally vanish by absorbing and redirecting ambient energy. By Imagine Me, Kenji becomes the novel's primary narrator, the lens through which readers see the war's final days. He challenges Warner's isolation, protects James like a little brother, and stands as Juliette's first and most loyal friend. His invisibility is both gift and metaphor — a boy who learned to make himself small to survive, who now chooses to be seen. His signature line: "Who says you can't be cute and kick ass at the same time? I do it every day."
